# German construction management platform Koppla raises €6M in funding

Potsdam-based startup Koppla, a collaborative scheduling platform for real-time construction project management, [has raised](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/lassesteffen_%F0%9D%97%9B%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%98%86-%F0%9D%97%AE%F0%9D%97%B9%F0%9D%97%B9-exciting-news-from-our-activity-7330152411606446080-yM_A?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADLXLE4BNNDbYnXXeV2wh_DxAc1SssTOf5c) €6 million from Earlybird Venture Capital, Coparion, and HPI Ventures.

- Founded in 2020 by Marco Trippler, Jerome Lange, and Lasse Steffen, [Koppla](https://www.koppla.de/) develops construction scheduling software that enables real-time planning and coordination across all project phases.
- The platform helps general contractors, project developers, and controllers manage schedules, track progress, and respond to changes efficiently.
- Koppla replaces traditional tools with a shared digital schedule where all stakeholders, from site managers to subcontractors, can collaborate.
- It offers features like drag-and-drop editing, standardized templates, and live updates, and works without requiring Lean experience. The software integrates into existing workflows to reduce planning time.

> _"With koppla, we’re building a tool that helps everyone involved in a project stay aligned, reduce friction, and deliver better outcomes. This funding helps us to continue improving the product and scale its impact across more projects and companies," co-founder of Koppla, Lasse Steffen,_ [_commented._](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/lassesteffen_%F0%9D%97%9B%F0%9D%97%B2%F0%9D%98%86-%F0%9D%97%AE%F0%9D%97%B9%F0%9D%97%B9-exciting-news-from-our-activity-7330152411606446080-yM_A?utm_source=share&utm_medium=member_desktop&rcm=ACoAADLXLE4BNNDbYnXXeV2wh_DxAc1SssTOf5c)

- More than 100 construction companies use Koppla to manage over 600 active projects, covering more than €15 billion in construction volume. Clients include Instone Real Estate, KVL Group, Implenia, Leonhard Weiss, Sprinkenhof, and MBN.

#### **Details of the deal**

- The investment saw support from existing investors like [Earlybird Venture Capital](https://earlybird.com/), [coparion](https://www.coparion.vc/), HPI Ventures, along with new investors such as [Newion](https://newion.com/), [Brandenburg Kapital GmbH](https://www.brandenburgkapital.de/), and several business angels.
- The €6 million funding will be used to improve Koppla’s product and grow the team in engineering, product, sales, and customer success to reach more construction projects and companies.
